transcript.statement: The TrustworthinessAgent emphasizes the importance of security and privacy in the library management system. Requirements TRU-01 and TRU-02 ensure that only authenticated members can borrow or return books and that all transactions are logged for auditability. TRU-03 mandates data encryption for personal information, safeguarding user data. TRU-04 establishes role-based access control, enhancing security. TRU-05 provides a secure mechanism for managing overdue books, while TRU-06 allows members to update their information securely. Lastly, TRU-07 enforces strong password policies to protect accounts. These requirements collectively ensure a secure and trustworthy system.

transcript.statement: The ResponsibilityAgent emphasizes the importance of ethical considerations and compliance in the library management system. Requirements RES-01 and RES-02 ensure data protection and accessibility for all users, promoting fairness. RES-03 and RES-04 enforce accountability and adherence to borrowing policies, while RES-05 ensures timely notifications for overdue books, fostering responsibility among members. RES-06 and RES-07 enhance transparency and allow for feedback, ensuring the system operates ethically and responsibly. These requirements collectively uphold the library's commitment to social responsibility and compliance with regulations.

transcript.statement: The GreenAgent emphasizes the necessity of sustainability in the library management system. Requirements GRN-01 and GRN-03 focus on minimizing energy consumption and reducing paper waste through digital notifications, respectively. GRN-02 ensures transparency in energy usage, while GRN-04 allows members to understand the carbon footprint of books. GRN-05 promotes responsible disposal of damaged books, and GRN-06 tracks energy savings from digital operations. Lastly, GRN-07 prioritizes e-books to reduce physical resource consumption. These requirements collectively ensure that the library operates in an environmentally responsible manner, aligning with modern sustainability goals.

transcript.statement: The SafetyAgent emphasizes the critical importance of safety and reliability in the library management system. Requirements SAF-01 through SAF-07 ensure that borrowing limits are enforced, overdue notifications are timely, inventory is accurately tracked, and data is backed up. These measures prevent unauthorized access, ensure accountability, and maintain operational integrity. SAF-03's real-time inventory status is crucial to prevent double borrowing, while SAF-04's backup mechanism safeguards against data loss. Each requirement contributes to a robust system that prioritizes user safety and reliability.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure that no member can borrow more than 5 books simultaneously.
The system shall automatically track and notify members of overdue books within 24 hours via a unified digital notification system.
The system shall maintain real-time inventory status of all books to prevent double borrowing.
The system shall provide a backup mechanism to recover all transaction data in case of a failure.
The system shall implement a user authentication process to ensure only registered members can access borrowing features.
The system shall log all transactions, including borrow and return actions, for audit purposes.
The system shall enable searching for books with a response time of under 2 seconds for 95% of queries.
The system shall track book availability and update the status in real-time to ensure accurate information.
The system shall process book returns within 1 second to maintain high throughput.
The system shall maintain an uptime of 99.5% to ensure consistent availability for users.
The library management system shall minimize energy consumption by using energy-efficient servers and infrastructure.
The system shall provide an energy usage report for library operations at least quarterly.
The library management system shall implement a recycling program for damaged books, ensuring proper disposal.
The system shall enforce data encryption for all member personal information stored.
The system shall provide an accessible interface for all users, including those with disabilities.
The system shall implement a feedback mechanism for members to report issues or suggestions regarding fairness in library services.
The system shall provide an annual report on usage statistics to ensure transparency in library operations.

conflict_resolutions.rationale: Limiting simultaneous borrow operations to 5 prevents unauthorized borrowing.
Both requirements address overdue notifications, creating a unified approach.
User authentication must align with role-based access control for security.
Conflicting goals of performance efficiency and energy efficiency remain.
